claims.exact_statement: For Boolean functions g,h on disjoint uniform cubes, U(gh)=U(g)+U(h), I(gh)=I(g)+I(h), and G(gh)=G(g)+G(h). Hence G-aI-bU is tensor additive and it suffices to prove any universal GU pair on tensor-prime Boolean functions. For every character lift F(a,y)=chi_R(a)g(y), U(F)=U(g), G(F)=G(g), and I(F)=I(g)+|R|. For each coordinate, the restriction KL term is exactly the m-weighted binary KL between the local signed asymmetry alpha and its upper-set signed average beta, with beta_empty=0 forced by Boolean convolution.
